subject: Medford Teachers Association Collective Bargaining Strategy
overview: The School Committee met briefly to vote to enter an executive session for the purpose of discussing collective bargaining strategy.

items.title: Call to Order and Pledge of Allegiance
items.summary: The meeting opened with a roll call and the recitation of the Pledge of Allegiance.

items.title: Executive Session for Collective Bargaining
items.summary: The committee approved a motion to enter executive session to discuss collective bargaining strategy regarding the Medford Teachers Association and did not reconvene in public session.
